atomic_facts.fact: Do Kwon was extradited from Montenegro to the United States.
He served about 17 months in jail in Montenegro before being extradited.
This was reported by AP News.
As of early 2026, Do Kwon is serving a 15-year federal prison sentence in the United States.
He received credit for time served in Montenegro.
The Montenegrin Ministry of Justice approved Do Kwon's extradition.
